The team reduce their level of contact and when contacts is involved, they apologise quickly. Good attitude towards everybody. Highfives around everytime!

spiritreceived.comments: Played with high spirit regardless of the score, continued to play MIXED ultimate when the going got tough better than other teams

The whole team was incredibly bubbly and positive throughout the game - cheering for our plays and high-fiving every single player on the team. It was a game with 0-limited calls - the way Ultimate should be played.
